# Pop faction types — synthetic fixture

faction_militarist = {
	name = militarist
	guiding_ethic = ethic_militarist
	use_guiding_ethic_as_faction_ethic = yes

	can_join_faction = {
		is_enslaved = no
		is_being_purged = no
	}

	attraction = {
		base = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 10
			has_ethic = ethic_militarist
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 20
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_militarist
		}
	}

	issues = {
		political_issue = {
			option = policy_military_professional_army
			title = political_issue_militarist_army
			effect = { faction_approval = 10 }
		}
		political_issue = {
			option = policy_diplomatic_closed_borders
			title = political_issue_militarist_borders
			effect = { faction_approval = 5 }
		}
	}

	demand = {
		name = militarist_demand_strong_military
		unfulfilled_effect = -10
		fulfilled_effect = 5
		trigger = {
			exists = owner
			owner = { has_tradition = tr_expansion_finish }
		}
	}
}

		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 20
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_materialist
		}
	}

	issues = {
		political_issue = {
			option = policy_economic_free_market
			title = political_issue_materialist_economy
			effect = { faction_approval = 10 }
		}
	}

	demand = {
		name = materialist_demand_research
		unfulfilled_effect = -5
		fulfilled_effect = 10

			exists = owner
			owner = { has_technology = tech_lasers }
		}
	}
}
